form.label: Oracle WebLogic Server and Access Overview
form.description: Operator dashboard for the conservative Oracle WebLogic server/access relay alpha slice. Panels are grounded in the synthetic-equivalent fixtures shipped with this pack (sourcetypes oracle:weblogic:server and oracle:weblogic:access); they are not proof of native WebLogic validation and no live SC4S/HEC/Splunk read-back has passed.

html.p: Scope caveat: this view covers only the fixture-backed relay sourcetypes oracle:weblogic:server and oracle:weblogic:access. Security Audit provider, Node Manager, and Fusion Middleware (SOA/OSB/BPM) grammars remain catalogue-only and blocked until source-backed samples and Splunk read-back are retained. Synthetic-equivalent fixtures are for onboarding and SPL quality only, not exploit detection or validation evidence.

search.query: | search subsystem="Security" OR message="*authentication*" OR message="*authoriz*" | stats count
| stats count by severity | sort - count
| stats count by subsystem | sort - count

panel.title: Server messages by managed server, subsystem and message id

search.query: | stats count values(severity) as severity latest(message) as latest_message by server_name machine_name subsystem message_id | sort - count

| search subsystem="Security" OR message="*authentication*" OR message="*authoriz*" OR severity IN ("Warning","Error","Critical","Alert","Emergency") | table _time server_name machine_name severity subsystem message_id user_id message sechub_fixture_marker | sort - _time
| stats count by status | sort - count
| stats count by src_ip http_method uri_path status | sort - count

panel.title: Onboarding coverage — fixture markers, sourcetype, index and source

search.query: index=$idx$ (sourcetype="oracle:weblogic:server" OR sourcetype="oracle:weblogic:access") sechub_fixture_marker="SC4S_ORACLE_WEBLOGIC_TEST_*" | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(index) as index values(source) as source by sourcetype sechub_fixture_marker | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen,"%F %T"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%F %T") | sort sourcetype sechub_fixture_marker

index=$idx$ (sourcetype="oracle:weblogic:server" OR sourcetype="oracle:weblogic:access") | table _time sourcetype source host severity status subsystem message_id server_name machine_name src_ip http_method uri_path sechub_fixture_marker _raw | sort - _time
